data.gender_notes: Arshiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arshiya is an Arabic name that means 'high-ranking' or 'exalted'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'arsh', which means 'throne' or 'high place'. The name Arshiya carries the meaning “High-ranking or exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arshiya usually hope their child will grow to embody high-ranking or exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Arshiya is seen as a name that reflects a person's high spiritual status, close to Allah's throne.
data.etymology: Arshiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “High-ranking or exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arshiya total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
